title: The Past Participle
subtitle: Riden, y-riden, sungen — optional y- prefix.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Strong verbs: y- prefix optional (riden or y-riden), vowel change from infinitive (sungen, comen, goon → gon). Weak verbs: loved. The y- prefix (from Old English ge-) is falling out of use in Chaucer's London dialect but survives in the West Midlands.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.
